title: automate-onboard-orionx-13b-v1.3-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Priya Khandelwal
description: Context: Onboard OrionX-13B v1.3 with performance profiles and surface automated changelog entries for model registry consumers. This PR implements the metadata and perf-profile artifacts for orionx-13b v1.3 and adds a changelog automation step to the onboarding pipeline so release notes are generated and attached automatically when a model is published. Motivation: reduce manual steps during model onboarding, ensure perf profiles and release notes are always present and consistent with model metadata. Changes summary: - Add model metadata JSON (schema-compliant) for orionx-13b v1.3 including supported precisions, recommended quantization profiles, tokenizer hints, and known capability tags. - Add perf profiles for representative workloads (chat-gen, completion, embeddings) with latency/throughput numbers and hardware mappings. - Implement a changelog generation job that consumes the model metadata and perf profile to create a draft changelog entry and append it to the model registry CHANGELOG.md via the automated workflow. - Extend onboarding CI to validate metadata against the registry schema and run lightweight perf checks in the perf-canary sandbox. - Add unit tests and e2e integration test for the changelog automation step. Checklist: - [x] Metadata schema files added and schema validation tests implemented - [x] Perf profiles added with measurement scripts - [x] Changelog automation implemented and covered by tests - [x] CI integration added (lint, unit, schema, canary perf) - [x] Docs update in redwood-model-registry/README.md describing onboarding automation How it works (short): The new workflow (/.github/workflows/onboard-model.yml) runs on PR merge to main for directories under models/orionx-13b/v1.3. The workflow validates metadata with registry-schema/validate.py, runs perf-canary smoke tests (containerized), and if checks pass it invokes tools/generate_changelog.py which renders a templated changelog entry (model, version, summary, perf highlights, recommended profiles, migration notes). The workflow then opens a small merge commit to add the generated changelog entry to models/CHANGELOG.md and tags the registry entry with v1.3. Performance notes: Perf profiles are derived from a 2-hour canary run on p4d-like instances with continuous-batching enabled. Highlights: - Chat (seq=1024): median token latency 18ms/token on p4d; stable 99th percentile under 40ms/token - Completion (seq=256): throughput up to 320 tokens/sec with continuous batching - Embeddings: 25ms per request (avg) with batch size 16 Recommendations included in metadata: default_precision: fp16, recommended_quant: awq-4/ggml-8 (where supported), fallback_cpu_variant: orionx-13b-cpu-quant. Migration/backcompat: v1.3 is fully backward compatible with v1.2 API surface; the only change is updated recommended quant profiles. Changelog automation details: - The generator extracts the following fields: model_name, version, tags, perf_summary, recommended_quant_profiles, known_issues. - Generated entry example is appended under models/CHANGELOG.md with a header '## orionx-13b v1.3'. - If the PR includes release_notes in PR metadata, those are merged into the generated text. Testing: - Unit tests for validate.py and generate_changelog.py live in tests/metadata and tests/changelog. - Integration test (tests/integration/onboard_changelog.test) spins up a lightweight mocked S3/registry and asserts the generated changelog matches expected templated output. - Perf smoke tests are in perf-canary/scripts/orionx-13b-smoke.sh and run in CI as a gated step. Rollout/ops notes: - The automation depends on service account 'registry-bot' having write access for the changelog commit. - If canary perf fails, the workflow blocks the changelog commit and posts a comment with logs. - There is a manual override flag in tools/generate_changelog.py --force to be used by platform admins for emergency publishes. Related work items: Linear ENG-4213 (onboarding automation), ENG-4289 (perf-profile standardization). Linked Jira: SUP-991 (customer request for orionx perf guidance). CI summary: initial CI run failed due to a missing dependency in perf-canary image (numpy pinned). Fixed in follow-up commit. Final CI status: all checks passing. Merge strategy: squash and merge. Notes for reviewers: focus on schema compliance and that generated changelog text doesn't include PII/log paths. Security & privacy: no model weights or secrets included in repo; perf artifacts are aggregated metrics only. Release notes: entries appended automatically; see release_notes field for suggested summary.
